entry.title: Sun Grown Torpedo — Single
experienceTags: Occasion: Long evening, after a meal, flavour benchmark
entry.summaryHtml: A Liga-like blast of pepper and spice opened the smoke, then the profile kept gaining complexity with a faint sweetness that developed into a distinct honeyed note. The strength stayed high rather than fading as the sweetness came forward. Construction was good rather than elite on this sample: the draw stayed tight and the burn was slightly uneven. Only roughly half of the Torpedo was smoked, so Quality stays at 8/10 while Strength and Flavour both earn 9/10.
entry.noteHtml: Tasted to roughly halfway. Tight draw and a slightly uneven burn prevent a Quality 9 on this sample. Cigar Hut currently lists the exact Sun Grown Torpedo at A$60 for a single and available to choose options. The existing Sun Grown Juniors remain separate; these ratings record the tasted Torpedo rather than extrapolating them to the smaller vitola.

note: Add the tasted Rocky Patel Sun Grown Torpedo as a separate taster at rank 1. User-approved ratings: Strength/Intensity 9, Quality 8, Flavour 9. Preserve the existing Sun Grown Juniors as a separate entry. Tasting notes: Liga-like pepper/spice opening, increasing complexity, faint sweetness developing into honey, high strength throughout, tight draw and slightly uneven burn; roughly half smoked. Official Rocky Patel specification confirms the 6.25 x 52 Torpedo and 5-year-old Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper; existing audited Sun Grown composition records Nicaraguan binder with Dominican/Nicaraguan filler.
